actionable_steps.citation: God and you are One — SSS Vol 20 (1987), 1987-07-11
actionable_steps.step: Begin the day by reminding yourself that the same Divinity lives in everyone you will meet, and look for it in them.

actionable_steps.citation: The One in the many — SSS Vol 22 (1989), 1989-06-25
actionable_steps.step: Treat every task at work or home as an offering to God, making no distinction between sacred work and ordinary work.

actionable_steps.citation: Recognise the principle of 'I' — SSS Vol 32 (1999), 1999-08-05
actionable_steps.step: When someone criticises you, pause instead of reacting, remembering that the one who accuses and the one accused share the same Atma.

actionable_steps.citation: Removal Of Immorality Is The Only Way To Immortality — SSS Vol 26 (1993), 1993-04-10
actionable_steps.step: Sit quietly and ask yourself, 'Am I the body? Am I the mind? Am I the senses?' until you rest in the answer, 'I am I.'

definition.citation: Purify The Mind And Focus It On Divinity — SSS Vol 35 (2002), 2002-10-13
definition.quote: What is wisdom? Advaita darshanam jnanam (perception of non-duality is wisdom). One should refine oneself in the fire of wisdom and experience non-dualism.

discourses.citation: I And You Are One — SSS Vol 34 (2001), 2001-07-05
discourses.quote: There is only one, not two. It is a sign of ignorance to think that there is something different from you and be in search of it. Multiplicity is your own imagination.

discourses.citation: God and you are One — SSS Vol 20 (1987), 1987-07-11
discourses.quote: Proceed from Dvaita (Dualism) to Vishishtadvaita (partial nondualism) and reach the stage of Advaitic (non-dual) Consciousness.

discourses.citation: The One in the many — SSS Vol 22 (1989), 1989-06-25
discourses.quote: Whatever work they do, whether in their office or elsewhere, they should consider it as an offering to God. In any business in which you engage yourself, treat it also as God's work. This is known as Bhava-Advaita (Advaitic attitude or attitude of oneness).

make_it_real: You are not the wave apart from the ocean — try living this one day as the ocean itself.
title: Non-duality (Advaita)

vahinis.quote: The statement, 'That thou art (Thath twam asi)' is found in the Upanishads... that the individual and God (jiva and Iswara) are the same. So, whether it is the Gita or the Upanishads, the teaching is non-duality, not duality or qualified monism.
